name: weighted seated calf raise v. 2
description: Seated calf raise with weight on your thighs that targets the soleus muscle under the calf.
instructions: Sit with the balls of your feet on a raised edge and weight resting on your knees.
Lower your heels until you feel a calf stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
